_comment: Model label -> EcoTaxa taxon id. Entries with a null id must be resolved by hand before use; loading this map will refuse them. Rebuild with ecotaxa_taxonomy_map.py build, re-check with check. Ambiguous entries carry a note saying what was rejected and why.

Ctenophora_Metazoa.note: comb jellies. NOT 17513 Ctenophora<Fragilariaceae, which is a diatom.

Copepoda.note: phylogenetic Class, matching ECOTAXA_TAXON_MAP in utils.py. NOT 94508, the morphological category.

living.note: the binary stage's positive verdict. Biota is EcoTaxa's root of everything alive; the taxon stage refines it where it ran, and objects it did not reach still arrive as 'alive, unsorted' rather than blank.

not-living.note: the binary stage's negative verdict, which IS a real EcoTaxa category, so those objects arrive labelled rather than blank.
